description: Fixture (General, dbVersion120). Six tables MN, MD, MC, MB, MR, MY (ID Long primary key, K TEXT(20), V1 of type Long, Date, Currency, Yes/No, Double, Byte), each the cross product of 5 Text keys (a, A, b, e-acute, Null) and the partner values (Null, negative, zero, positive and extreme values, negative-fraction dates), stored through a table-type recordset with the typed VARIANT of the partner. After the rows, five compound indexes per table: (K, V1), (V1, K), (K DESC, V1), (K, V1 DESC), (K DESC, V1 DESC); an image is kept after each index of MN and after each table's set. MN2 has the same five indexes created before its rows, added by INSERT..SELECT from MN. Asks what the public path stores for each typed value and Null.
retentionNote: Designed r-sort-3b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
